title: Every customer is on Default for work orders and Part Sales
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data' and 'Customers — View'.
  • Use the staging site, where the Tiered Pricing release is deployed on top of data from before the release.
  • Use a staging client on which nobody has set up tiers or changed a matrix since the release: its Tiers list shows only Default and the Audit Log of its Matrices list shows no event.
  • Open Customers and note how many customers the client has (for example 24).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Point at Default's number in the Customers column.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Default's Customers column shows the same number as the Customers list (24 = 24).
  • Each customer is counted once.

Step 2:

  • The hover shows the work orders count and the Part Sales count, each equal to the customer count (24 and 24).
